query:
Two members pushed back on Dani's ridgeline proposal and both seemed to prefer easier terrain. Who brought up the social element of hiking as a reason to go with the flatter route?

Options:
A. Bev
B. Dani
C. Marcus
D. Yusuf
context:
[1] (about=Bev, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:37:00) Cass makes a fair point about Millbrook honestly! Plus we could actually talk on the flat 😂 the ridgeline everyone is too breathless for a conversation
[2] (about=Bev, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T16:51:00) Dani... 800m and a scramble?? 😅 whatever happened to the social side of this group
[3] (about=Bev, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:08:00) Cass and I vote woodland. Marcus probably does too. Dani the group speaks 😂
[4] (about=Cass, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:31:00) does the ridgeline go over the upper plateau? I'd actually prefer a woodland section, the Millbrook loop goes through Hartley Wood
[5] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:43:00) Millbrook. Democracy has spoken, Dani.
[6] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:35:00) Ridgeline is manageable. Fine with either.
[7] (about=Bev, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T18:55:00) I was going to say mostly exposed ridge means nowhere to stop for tea either 😂 is there a woodland variant?
[8] (about=Dani, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:10:00) FINE. Someone find a woodland route with 700m gain and I'll consider it 😤🏔️
[9] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:12:00) A woodland route with solid gain does exist. They're simply less fashionable than exposed ridges.
[10] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:04:00) Late August I can do. Stanmore is steep. The south descent is manageable.
